call_points.text: No FY27 revenue or volume target given; management said fertilizer per-tonne margin is too volatile to model.
DAP and urea margins are fully protected by the government; NPK grades may vary plus or minus 5-10%.
Caprolactam-benzene spread is above $800/MT versus about $670/MT in Q4FY26.
Q1FY27 industrial demand is mixed: melamine and technical grade urea face softer demand; HX Crystal demand is constant.
Elevated caprolactam and nylon 6 prices from Q4FY26 are unlikely to hold, leaving realisations under pressure.
The company capitalised growth projects aggregating over ₹670 Cr in FY26.
No long-term debt; subsidy dues received for urea to the fourth week of April 2026 and P&K to the third week.
Sulfur is at $850/MT internationally; GSFC holds sulfuric acid inventory from old long-term contracts, covering Q1.
Monsoon progress and possible El Nino are the key swing factors for Q1FY27 fertilizer demand.
NBS rates for H1FY27 were revised with a 10% uplift across nitrogen, phosphorus and sulfur nutrients.

operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 Industrial Products segment result was ₹112.85 Cr against ₹8.57 Cr in Q3FY26, while Fertilizer Products posted a ₹28.63 Cr loss.
Government subsidies receivable stood at ₹1,452.88 Cr at 31 March 2026, up from ₹1,087.47 Cr a year earlier.
FY26 capex was ₹307.78 Cr, down 18.9% from ₹379.54 Cr in FY25.
FY26 fertilizer volumes rose 12% to 22.31 LMT from 19.88 LMT, with Urea, APS and AS the key contributors.
FY26 fertilizer production was 17.59 LMT, the highest in the last 5 financial years.
Capro-Benzene spread averaged USD 535 per MT in FY26 versus USD 578 per MT in FY24-25.
Caprolactam-benzene spread was above $800/MT in May 2026 versus about $670/MT in Q4FY26.
Sulfur traded at $850/MT internationally; sulfuric acid inventory from old long-term contracts covers Q1FY27.
Ammonia stock was about 16,000 MT at the Baroda complex, with both ammonia trains running at 100%.
Board approved setting up 600 MTPD Phosphoric Acid and 1,800 MTPD Sulphuric Acid plant at Sikka Unit, Jamnagar.
CRISIL ESG Ratings & Analytics assigned an independent overall ESG rating of 62.
